findings.text: **Connections cross unrelated nodes** `relationshipLayout` draws every non-self connection as a straight line. A connection from the first node to the third crosses the second node, whose box is drawn over the line. Readers can mistake that unrelated node for part of the relationship. The full connection table stays correct, so this is non-blocking, but the diagram requires cross-checking. Route connections around intervening boxes. Note: If this suggestion doesn't match your team's coding style, reply to this and let me know. I'll remember it for next time!
